hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing dynamic swap fees based on oracle-tracked volatility and surge pricing, full-range liquidity management with fee reinvestment, and a truncated geometric price oracle. In addition to the declared protocol fee, charges a hardcoded undisclosed 0.10% "AGGRESSIVE_SURGE" fee on every swap (labeled "Скрытая комиссия" — hidden commission — in source comments), with both fees minted to the liquidity manager.
